title: Janitorial and Custodial Services for the County Administration Complex and Satellite Facilities
summary: Larkspur County, Ohio wants a janitorial contractor to clean five County buildings (about 148,000 square feet) every night, provide a day porter at the Courthouse, and do periodic floor and carpet care. This is physical cleaning work with minimum daily labour hours, background-checked staff, bonds and a local supervisor. It involves no software.

fit_factors.reason: This is janitorial and custodial cleaning, physical labour with no software component.
It needs nightly cleaning crews of more than 70 labour hours a day across five buildings in Ohio.
It requires 5 years of janitorial experience, current 25,000+ sq. ft. cleaning contracts and a local supervisor within 30 miles.
The contract value is not stated. The award goes to the lowest responsive bidder.
The mandatory site walk is December 3, 2026 and sealed proposals are due December 15, 2026.

reasons: Not our work: the scope is nightly janitorial cleaning and floor care for 148,000 sq. ft., with no software, automation or AI.
Pass/fail requirements we can't meet: 5 years of commercial janitorial experience, three current large cleaning contracts and a local supervisor within 30 miles.
Heavy field obligations: a mandatory in-person site walk, bid and performance bonds, and fingerprint-checked cleaning crews.
change_mind: The County issued a separate solicitation for software, such as a facilities work-order or inspection app, related to this contract.
A janitorial prime contractor invited idiaz.io to supply quality-control or shift-logging software as a subcontractor.
